privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: How {name} collects and uses the information you share when enquiring about treatment.
privacy.whoWeAreBody: This website is operated by {legalName} (“we”, “us”), a dental clinic based in {city}, {country}.
privacy.noDataTitle: This website does not collect personal data
privacy.noDataBody: There is no contact form, quote form, newsletter signup or tracking on this site. Every contact path — WhatsApp, phone, email — hands you off directly to that platform (WhatsApp, your phone's dialler, your email client) rather than submitting anything to us through this website. We do not receive, store or process any personal data as a result of you browsing or using the contact links on this site.
privacy.directContactBody: If you message us on WhatsApp, call, or email, any information you choose to share (such as your name, contact details or photos) is handled by us as part of responding to your enquiry, under the privacy terms of WhatsApp or your email provider for that channel. We use it only to respond to you and do not sell it or use it for unrelated marketing.
privacy.cookiesBody: This site does not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies, and does not use local/session storage to store personal data.
privacy.questionsBody: If you have a question about this policy, contact us at
